prior_lessons: AAI-02B INVALID because scrambled-label negative exceeded fixed ceiling; AAI-03A negative admission because Bayes utility matched privileged expert. Those results stay sealed, without post-result tuning.
hypothesis: With 12 possible transition laws across four structurally different causal families, only two noisy interventions and a two-action irreversible decision, exact Bayes retains a measurable advantage over uninformative probing yet fails to reach privileged true-law performance, so the benchmark has scientific headroom.

world.law_space: 4 families x 3 variants = 12 latent laws, all 12 considered by exact Bayes, including held-out families. Variant hidden from all nonexpert arms.
world.train_dev_families: 0-1 only; families are h(seed,'family')%2. Variant h(seed,'variant')%3.
world.transfer_negative_families: 2-3 only; family 2+h(seed,'family')%2. Variant h(seed,'variant')%3. No transfer training.
world.context: seed%16, observable but does not reveal hidden law.
world.transition: L=3*family+variant; F0: next=rol3(state,variant+1) XOR [1,2,4,7][action]; F1: next=(state+(variant+1)*(action+1))%8; F2: next=(reverse3(state XOR [1,2,4,7][action])+variant+action+1)%8; F3: next=(((state*(2*variant+1))%8) XOR ((action+2*variant+1)%8))%8.
world.interventions: Two independent diagnostic do(state,action) probes, chosen adaptively from 16 allowed state/action combinations: states [0,2,5,7] and all four actions. True successor returned with P=.65, otherwise exactly one of three successor bits flipped with equal probability. Independent SHA256 keyed noise per seed and probe index.
world.decision: After probes, 32 passive law-independent distractor records arrive; then choose an OPEN-LOOP TWO-ACTION PLAN (a1,a2) among 16. Compute s1=transition(law,s0,a1), s2=transition(law,s1,a2). Reward=1-hamming_bits(s2,target)/3; terminal s0 and target each drawn by independent SHA256 labels, not from hidden law.
world.passive: 32 records after probes, fields generated solely from seed,index,context, never from hidden law; positive control must retain do observations within 4-slot event memory; negative recent buffer loses them.
world.unobserved: Hidden law/family/variant, noiseless probe result, alternative outcome for unchosen final plans, evaluation labels. Observable fields: context, intervention state/action/noisy 3-bit successor, do marker, timestamp, terminal initial state and target.

methods.bayes_utility: Exact 12-law uniform prior with correct law/observation/noise likelihood; choose each probe maximizing expected *one-step lookahead terminal plan reward after hypothetical observation*, replan before second probe. MAP decoding prohibited; choose two-step terminal plan by maximum expected reward.
methods.bayes_information_gain: Same exact 12-law posterior but greedy conditional entropy reduction for probe choice, same terminal planner.
methods.bayes_random: Same exact posterior/terminal planner, SHA256-random probes from same 16 choices.
methods.bayes_no_probe: Same exact posterior/terminal planner with no do observations.
methods.tabular_mle: Fully fit Laplace-count model P(observed successor|law,state,action) using 512 train worlds, two deterministic random probes per training world. Same random probes, four-slot buffer and terminal planner at evaluation. No unseen family labels trained.
methods.tabular_shuffled: Identical trained tabular likelihood but TRAIN law labels deterministically permuted with random.Random(10337), evaluated only on negative cohort.
methods.bayes_sham: Same exact Bayesian inference but receive synthetic independent uniform 3-bit values for two do probes instead of law-dependent outcomes, evaluated on negative cohort.
methods.recent: Exact Bayesian posterior but keep only 4 most recent events including 32 passive events, losing causal probes.
methods.expert: Privileged true-law terminal two-action planner, upper bound excluded from scientific advantage comparator.

controls.identifiability: Exhaustively assert 12 law functions distinguishable pairwise by some s,a over 8 states x 4 actions.
controls.no_leakage: Passive, goal and terminal start unchanged when hidden law swapped in same seed; no law fields appear in event buffer.
controls.cold_restore: Serialized fitted tabular counts reload and reproduce predictions; deterministic reruns exclude runtime only.
controls.cost: Report model calls (0), probe counts, training event counts, wall time; strong Bayes prior family catalog is given structural information, not proof of generalization to unseen mechanism.

admission.pass_required: All nine thresholds AND audit/custody/budget checks. Otherwise BENCHMARK_REJECTED_VALID_NEGATIVE, unless code/source/leakage invalidates primary.
admission.statistical_report: Per-world paired differences vs Bayes random and no-probe, mean, deterministic empirical 95% bootstrap CI with frozen resample seed=10404, 1024 replicates; no post-result model choice.
admission.science_status: Only BENCHMARK_ADMITTED_DEV candidate if all requirements pass, NOT scientific improvement or native Yggdrasil acceptance. A novel associative mechanism remains separate AAI-04B requiring new prereg.

authority: External contributor experiment; no native model/weights/controller/runner/queue/accepted-ref/promotion/deployment; no scheduled tasks
